architecture.mechanism: Biomimetic thermoelectric and thermoregulatory energy storage and release, inspired by insect biological systems, enabling stable generation, storage, and release of energy under varying conditions.
architecture.intervention: Integrate a biomimetic thermoelectric voltage regulation module into the automotive 12V battery electrical system that mimics insect thermoregulatory energy management, maintaining stable voltage output during battery discharge events to prevent electronic module code loss and preserve starting capacity.
architecture.expected_effect: Electronic module codes are preserved during low-voltage events and battery starting capacity is restored, as the biomimetic system provides regulated energy release even when the primary battery voltage drops below critical thresholds.
architecture.falsification_test: Subject the modified 12V battery system to a controlled 24-hour low-voltage discharge simulation (matching the documented failure scenario) and measure whether electronic module codes remain intact and whether the system can successfully restart the vehicle after the discharge period.
